variants.title: Half subtractor from NAND gates
variants.unknown: the difference and borrow truth table of the half subtractor
variants.note: Difference = A xor B, borrow = A'.B: a borrow is needed only when nothing is being taken from something.

source.title: Texas Instruments SN5400/SN7400 datasheet (SDLS025); M. Morris Mano, Digital Design, subtractors

variants.title: Full subtractor from NAND gates
variants.unknown: the difference and borrow truth table of the full subtractor
variants.note: It also takes a borrow coming in, so there are eight rows; the difference is the same function as an adder's sum.

source.title: Texas Instruments SN5400/SN7400 datasheet (SDLS025); M. Morris Mano, Digital Design, subtractors
